title: AI卖铲子交易：太拥挤，有人开始减持，权益资产领导力将如何切换？
speaker: Helen Zhu

segments.en: You didn't mention about the AI picks and shovels trade. Might have gone too far.
segments.zh: 你没提到AI的“卖铲子”交易。可能已经走得太远了。

segments.en: How do you look at equity leadership then for the rest of the year now?
segments.zh: 那么今年余下时间你怎么看权益资产领涨？

segments.en: Or even into 2027? I think it's going to be a little bit difficult, Evonne.
segments.zh: 甚至到2027年？Evonne，我觉得会有点困难。

segments.en: I think people are taking some chips off the table after having had a pretty spectacular year earlier in the year.
segments.zh: 我认为在年初经历相当亮眼的表现后，人们正在减持一些仓位。

segments.en: And given that the newly elected officials won't take office until late January.
segments.zh: 鉴于新当选官员要到1月底才上任。

segments.en: And we probably won't see the extent of their policy conviction until maybe later on in the spring.
segments.zh: 我们可能要到春季晚些时候才能看到他们政策信念的程度。

segments.en: I think there's going to be a lot of uncertainty for the AI picks and shovels specifically.
segments.zh: 我认为具体到AI的“卖铲子”领域，将会有很多不确定性。

segments.en: And with that, because of the knock on implications it may have for the wealth effect in the US and the overall confidence in the economy.
segments.zh: 因此，由于这可能对美国财富效应和整体经济信心产生连锁影响。

segments.en: As well as the fact that as we move along next year, you'll probably get more and more news about the deflationary impacts of AI, whether it's impacting layoffs and strength
segments.zh: 而且随着明年推进，你可能会看到越来越多关于AI通缩影响的新闻，无论是影响裁员还是实力

segments.en: and the payrolls that we've seen for quite a long time already.
segments.zh: 以及我们已经看到相当长时间的就业数据。

segments.en: I think that's going to potentially bring some concerns into the overall market.
segments.zh: 我认为这可能会给整体市场带来一些担忧。

segments.en: But on the margin, I think the sectors that might improve would be the ones where they were rate sensitive.
segments.zh: 但边际上，可能改善的板块是那些对利率敏感的。

segments.en: So rates are coming down a little bit or oil price sensitive.
segments.zh: 所以利率在小幅下降，或者对油价敏感的。

segments.en: So obviously that is more driven by what's happening in the Middle East but just though unclear.
segments.zh: 显然这更多是由中东局势驱动的，但还不明确。

segments.en: But what we see is that people have been very lowly positioned or even short some of those sectors.
segments.zh: 但我们看到的是，人们在这些板块的仓位一直很低，甚至做空。

segments.en: So those might actually have a little bit of a bounce and kind of bring on some new leadership.
segments.zh: 所以这些板块实际上可能会有所反弹，并带来一些新的领涨力量。
